proof_rule: SEPARATED iff the full connected extended class contains a concrete witness f and the baseline class has a canonical Agda proof that f is not representable.

scope.restriction: No isolated attention-only, Haar-only, recurrence-only, optimizer-only, or factor-only separation claims. Every candidate witness must traverse the connected full learner composition.

connected_composition.role: baseline neural function class with explicitly fixed resource restrictions
lifts exact full-state trajectories into a bounded observed factor representation
factor-level recurrence witness mechanism without full-state recurrence
topological observation closure built on the connected learner boundary
function class induced by the entire connected composition

edges: baseline embeds into the full connected architecture only if the resource-preserving inclusion is proved
full learner state composes with the existing Haar/sparsemax closure
full-state representation is connected to bounded factor lifting
bounded factor lift supplies the exact-state/factor distinction used by factor recurrence
factor recurrence is interpreted through the endogenous observation boundary

finite information boundary participates in exact RNN-LM observation capability

the entire connected composition defines the extended class
separation_obligation: prove F_base subseteq F_full_connected under identical input/output semantics
construct one concrete f in F_full_connected using the entire connected path
prove f notin F_base with a canonical nonrepresentability theorem
register the witness and nonrepresentability theorem on the Agda surface
make theorem_graph_search and theorem_monolith_egraph_sync discover the same connected path

reason: The repository has the connected composition surfaces and factor-recurrence mechanism, but it does not yet contain the strict nonrepresentability witness needed for a neural function-class separation, nor a theorem proving that a specific regularizer mathematically forces or predicts factor recurrence.
no_invention_policy: Do not invent a new exotic theorem merely to complete the graph. Existing pre-graphed theorem surfaces are used first; new theorem promotion requires an actual Agda proposition.
